name: Layout Image
summary: Text to image with MOSS-Image (Apache-2.0); also takes a layout JSON that places each text and object in its own box.

source.notes: MOSS-Image SFT, int8. Its Qwen3.5-9B text encoder also rewrites a short prompt into a caption. A layout prompt is the JSON MOSSImageLayoutPrompt writes: {"summary": {"caption": ...}, "items": [{"label": "text"|"object"|"character", "caption": ..., "text": ..., "bbox": [y0, x0, y1, x1]}], "bbox_coord_space": "abs_centralized", "bbox_format": "yxyx"} (pixels, origin at the centre); turn the rewrite off for it. Cloud9 validation: native INT8 diffusion and W4A8 Qwen3.5-9B, direct prompt, 1024x1024, 25 er_sde steps; complete Freefield CLI render in 1112.4 seconds without a memory-guard trip. Optional prompt rewriting and larger sizes were not qualified by that test. Native ComfyUI Fast Preview verified on Cloud9 gfx1103 2026-11-20: 4 steps Euler CFG1 + akhaliq v2 LoRA strength 1.0, same 1024px bicycle prompt/seed: 291.30 s, max GTT 4.486 GiB, min RAM avail 16.989 GiB, PSI max 2.66%. Quality 25step/er_sde remains default, no second MOSS DiT or encoder; LoRA xfs symlink. Receipt validation/moss-sft-euler-4step-int8-1024-20261120.json. Fast preview visual tradeoff: smoother surfaces and minor mechanical bicycle detail differences.

inputs.label: Prompt or layout JSON
inputs.default: A minimalist concert poster: the title "MIDNIGHT TACOS" in huge bold letters at the top, "LIVE · FRIDAY 9 PM" below it, a neon taco truck at night, risograph print, hot pink and teal

inputs.label: Rewrite my prompt
inputs.help: Optional caption expansion adds CPU preparation time on Cloud9. Direct prompting is the validated default; keep rewrite off for a layout JSON.

inputs.label: Fast preview (4 steps)
inputs.help: Optional MOSS Euler-native 4-step LoRA. 291.3 s for 1024px on Cloud9 vs 1118.2 s quality reference; visual result smoother. When on, fixed 4-step Euler CFG1 overrides quality Steps slider. Quality 25 steps remains unchanged by default.

inputs.label: Steps
inputs.help: Quality mode only (20–60 steps). Fast preview always uses 4 steps Euler CFG1.
